(modifying a numeral, one to twelve) In conjunction with a numeral, indicates the time within a twelve-hour period (midnight to noon or noon to midnight), specifically the time when the hour hand of a clock points precisely to the symbol or marking corresponding to the designated numeral, i.e., at…

(humorous, informal) Used to indicate that it is time to do a specific action, or time for a specific action to occur.
I'm feeling peckish; I think it must be nearly dinner o'clock.
